== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will maintain this skill both in and out of combat to support upkeep of echoes.

== Notes ==
* This chant is triggered the next time an attack skill is successfully activated.
* The condition is applied before the attack hits.
* If used with [[Attack#Related skills|area of effect attack skills]], such as [[Whirlwind Attack]], the [[condition]] will only apply to your target, not every foe you hit with it.

== Trivia ==
* The person depicted in the [[skill icon]] appears to be [[Jora]] in her default armor.
